verses.1: And he couldn’t stand up to all those who were in charge of him. So, they called out for everyone to get down from above. No one stood up against him. Then Yosef went to his brothers.
verses.2: And he blew his trumpet, and the nations heard it. And Pharaoh’s house also heard it.
verses.3: And Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph. My father is still alive. But his brothers couldn’t confront him, because they were terrified by him.”
verses.4: And Joseph said to his brothers, “Come to me.” They came and said, “We are Joseph’s brothers; you sold us from Egypt.”
verses.5: And now, do not be discouraged or feel sad in your hearts. For you have purchased me from God’s hands. I am now alive because of God’s grace before you.
verses.6: For these two years have been years of hunger in this land. And there have been five more years during which there was no harvest or grain.
verses.7: And God sent me before you, so that I might establish your rest on the earth and bring about great salvation for you.
verses.8: And now, you have not sent me away here. For God has made me an ancestor to Pharaoh, and a ruler over all his house. I am also the ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.9: Hurry up and go to my father. Say to him, “Your son Joseph has said, ‘God has set me as the king of all Egyptians. Come to me; do not stand still.’”
verses.10: And you shall dwell in a land of suffering. You will be close to me, you and your children, and your descendants, and all those who follow you.
verses.11: And I will destroy you there, because it’s still five years before you and your house will be destroyed. And everything else that belongs to you as well.
verses.12: And now, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benyamin also see, that what I say to you is true.
verses.13: And you have told my father all about my glory in Egypt, and everything you saw there. You also brought my father back here.
verses.14: And he fell on Binyamin’s shoulders. And Binyamin also fell on his own shoulders.
verses.15: And he cursed all his brothers. Then his brothers spoke to him.
verses.16: And a cry was heard from Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Yosef’s brothers have come!” This news pleased Pharaoh and his servants.
verses.17: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers that they should do this. They should go into their own cities and leave the land as it is.”
verses.18: And take your fathers and mothers with you, and come to Me. I will give you the good things of the land of Egypt. Then you may eat the milk of the land.
verses.19: And you were commanded to do this: Take your donkeys from the land of Egypt, so that they can carry you and help you. Then you will be able to carry your ancestors with you.
verses.20: And your eyes shall not look on all of you, for the good that is in all the land of Egypt is yours as well.
verses.21: And so did the children of Israel. Joseph gave them donkeys as gifts, according to Pharaoh’s commandment. He also provided them with provisions for their journey.
verses.22: To everyone else, he gave them three pairs of clothes. To Bethany, he gave her three pieces of silver and five pairs of clothes.
verses.23: And his father sent twelve camels, carrying goods from Egypt. He also sent ten bags of grain, bread, and honey to his father on his way.
verses.24: And he sent out his brothers, and they went away. He said to them, “Do not get angry along the way.”
verses.25: And they went up from Egypt and came into the land of Canaan, to their father Jacob.
verses.26: And they told him, “Yosaf is still alive. He rules over all of Egypt’s lands. But his heart was troubled, because he didn’t believe them.”
verses.27: And they told him all the words that Joseph had spoken to them. Then he saw the chariots that Joseph had sent to carry him away. And Yaakov’s spirit revived.
verses.28: And Israel said, “Rab Oded-Yosuf, my son, live on! Let us see you again before it’s too late.”
